name: Houryouzaki Kasuka
source:
"Nothing good ever comes from being involved with me, you know."

Occupation: Unknown

I want to cherish it (you). Don't mind me.

About 25 years ago, I met a man at a haunted place that was the site of an apartment fire which was caused by a stove accident. At first, he was wearing a paper bag, and I could not make out his age, let alone his expression.

   He always appears there when the sun goes down, and he warns you not to come back, but eventually stops giving you the cold shoulder as you continue coming. It seems that he knew you one way or another, and he does many strange things such as correctly guessing your last name.
